dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 17, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Dominant Performances Across the League**

The Tampa Bay Rays shut out the Miami Marlins 6-3, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win and Bryan Baker earning the save. Junior Caminero shone at the plate for the Marlins, hitting a home run and driving in two runs. In the American League, Gunnar Henderson led the Baltimore Orioles to a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, going 4-for-5 with a home run and two RBIs.

Meanwhile, the Philadelphia Phillies blanked the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-0, with Zack Wheeler tossing a complete game shutout and striking out eight. Bryce Harper, Alec Bohm, and Bryson Stott each had strong performances at the plate. The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox 8-1, with Austin Riley hitting a home run and driving in three runs.

In other action, the Cleveland Guardians routed the Cincinnati Reds 10-3, with Kyle Manzardo hitting two home runs and driving in three runs. Gavin Williams earned the win, striking out seven in six innings. The Toronto Blue Jays edged the Detroit Tigers 4-1, with Vladimir Guerrero Jr. hitting a home run and driving in one run.

The New York Mets stunned the New York Yankees 7-6, with Devin Williams earning the win in relief. Tyrone Taylor hit a home run and drove in three runs for the Mets. The Texas Rangers blanked the Houston Astros 8-0, with Nathan Eovaldi tossing a complete game shutout and striking out eight. Jake Burger hit a home run and drove in four runs for the Rangers.

The Chicago White Sox edged the Chicago Cubs 9-8, with Edgar Quero hitting a home run and driving in three runs. The Minnesota Twins edged the Milwaukee Brewers 5-4, with Bailey Ober earning the win in relief. The Kansas City Royals blanked the St. Louis Cardinals 2-0, with Salvador Perez hitting a home run and driving in two runs.

The Arizona Diamondbacks rallied to beat the Colorado Rockies 8-6, with Corbin Carroll hitting two home runs and driving in three runs. The San Francisco Giants dominated the Athletics 10-1, with Harrison Bader hitting a grand slam and driving in four runs. The Los Angeles Dodgers routed the Los Angeles Angels 10-1, with Roki Sasaki tossing a complete game shutout and striking out eight.

Finally, the San Diego Padres edged the Seattle Mariners 8-3, with Gavin Sheets hitting two home runs and driving in four runs.
